book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第一册
unit_cn: Unit 1 Laugh Out Loud! 开怀大笑
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修一 Unit 1 词表(p107 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、幽默/小丑医生/笑主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: A few good jokes can quickly put you in a happy mood.
words.example_cn: 几个好笑话能很快让你心情愉快。

words.example_en: The clown first learned his funny tricks at a travelling circus.
words.example_cn: 这个小丑最初在一个流动马戏团学会了他的滑稽把戏。

words.example_en: The children watched the clown with great amusement.
words.example_cn: 孩子们饶有兴致地看着小丑。

words.example_en: You can often see clowns making people laugh at an amusement park.
words.example_cn: 在游乐场你常能看到小丑逗人发笑。

words.example_en: The clown put on a bright curly rainbow wig before his show.
words.example_cn: 演出前小丑戴上了一顶鲜艳的卷曲彩虹假发。

words.example_en: His funny wig and red nose made all the children laugh.
words.example_cn: 他滑稽的假发和红鼻子把所有孩子都逗笑了。

words.example_en: His name badge read 'Doctor Laugh-Out-Loud'.
words.example_cn: 他的名牌上写着'开怀大笑医生'。

words.example_en: The little girl had hurt her ankle and was crying in pain.
words.example_cn: 小女孩扭伤了脚踝,正疼得直哭。

words.example_en: A clown doctor cheers up children who are ill in hospital.
words.example_cn: 小丑医生为住院的患病儿童带去欢乐。

words.example_en: Clown doctors entertain young patients with magic tricks and jokes.
words.example_cn: 小丑医生用魔术和笑话给小患者带来欢乐。

words.example_en: Clown doctors work in hospitals and other health care places.
words.example_cn: 小丑医生在医院和其他医疗保健场所工作。

words.example_en: We sing silly songs to cheer up the children on the ward.
words.example_cn: 我们唱滑稽的歌来让病房里的孩子们高兴起来。

words.example_en: A funny joke often does the trick when a child feels sad.
words.example_cn: 当孩子难过时,一个好笑的笑话常常很奏效。

words.example_en: While the doctor examined her ankle, the clown did a magic trick.
words.example_cn: 医生检查她脚踝时,小丑变了个魔术。

words.example_en: The hospital put out an advertisement for a part-time clown doctor.
words.example_cn: 医院登了一则招聘兼职小丑医生的广告。

words.example_en: The Healthy Humour Foundation is the clown doctor's employer.
words.example_cn: 健康幽默基金会是这位小丑医生的雇主。

words.meaning_cn: 极其重要的;必不可少的
words.example_en: Humour has been an essential part of human life for thousands of years.
words.example_cn: 幽默几千年来一直是人类生活必不可少的一部分。

words.meaning_cn: 使钦佩;给……留下深刻印象
words.example_en: He told a clever joke that he hoped would impress his friends.
words.example_cn: 他讲了个聪明的笑话,希望能让朋友们佩服。

words.example_en: She could not help but grin at his silly joke.
words.example_cn: 听到他愚蠢的笑话,她忍不住咧嘴笑了。

words.example_en: After such a hard day, the tired nurses deserve a good laugh.
words.example_cn: 辛苦了一天,疲惫的护士们应该好好笑一场。

words.example_en: Why the long face? Here is a joke to cheer you up.
words.example_cn: 怎么愁眉苦脸的?给你讲个笑话开心一下。

words.example_en: After he fell over, he became the laughing stock of the whole class.
words.example_cn: 摔了一跤后,他成了全班的笑柄。

words.example_en: Even the strict teacher began to crack a smile at the joke.
words.example_cn: 连严厉的老师都被那个笑话逗得露出了笑容。

words.example_en: On April Fool's Day, people love to play a practical joke on each other.
words.example_cn: 愚人节那天,人们喜欢互相搞恶作剧。

words.example_en: Mark Twain won fame for his witty remarks and funny stories.
words.example_cn: 马克·吐温因风趣的言论和好笑的故事而成名。

words.example_en: Lin Yutang was a writer and linguist who loved humour.
words.example_cn: 林语堂是一位热爱幽默的作家兼语言学家。

words.meaning_cn: 说话风趣的;妙趣横生的
words.example_en: Twain was famous for his witty replies to ordinary people.
words.example_cn: 吐温以对普通人妙趣横生的回答而闻名。

words.example_en: Even medieval writings are filled with clever jokes.
words.example_cn: 甚至中世纪的著作里也充满了巧妙的笑话。

words.example_en: Humour can throw new light on emotive or sensitive issues.
words.example_cn: 幽默能为令人激动或敏感的话题带来新的视角。

words.example_en: Twain's writing is funny and often a little mischievous.
words.example_cn: 吐温的文字诙谐,而且常常有点调皮。

words.example_en: He is well known for his witty remarks in everyday life.
words.example_cn: 他以日常生活中风趣的言论而广为人知。

words.example_en: His funny remarks often came out of everyday interaction with people.
words.example_cn: 他风趣的话常常来自与人们的日常交流。

words.example_en: Twain once went into a barber's shop for a haircut.
words.example_cn: 吐温有一次走进一家理发店去剪头发。

words.example_en: He went into the shop for a haircut and a shave.
words.example_cn: 他走进店里去剪头发、刮胡子。

words.example_en: 'I always have to stand when that fellow lectures,' he joked.
words.example_cn: '那家伙演讲时我总得站着,'他打趣道。

words.example_en: Lin Yutang became famous for his own unique brand of humour.
words.example_cn: 林语堂以自己独特风格的幽默而闻名。

words.example_en: He brought the modern concept of humour to Chinese literature.
words.example_cn: 他把现代的幽默概念带入了中国文学。

words.example_en: The president put Lin on the spot by suddenly asking for a speech.
words.example_cn: 校长突然请林语堂讲话,让他当场为难。

words.example_en: Lin told a story about a cruel emperor and some wild animals.
words.example_cn: 林语堂讲了一个关于残忍皇帝和野兽的故事。

words.example_en: The man bent down to whisper something in the lion's ear.
words.example_cn: 那人弯下腰在狮子耳边悄声说了句话。

words.example_en: Lin's audience roared with laughter at his little joke.
words.example_cn: 林语堂的听众被他的小笑话逗得哄堂大笑。

words.example_en: With the joke, he gently told off the president.
words.example_cn: 他用这个笑话温和地数落了校长一番。

words.example_en: Humour is a tool that can be used to illuminate the world.
words.example_cn: 幽默是一种可以用来照亮世界的工具。

words.example_en: Lin created an equation: Reality plus Dreams plus Humour equals Wisdom.
words.example_cn: 林语堂创造了一个等式:现实加梦想加幽默等于智慧。

words.meaning_cn: 难处理的;难懂的;复杂的
words.example_en: Working with others can be complicated, but humour makes it easier.
words.example_cn: 与人共事可能很复杂,但幽默能让它变得容易些。

words.example_en: A punch line is used to conclude a joke and make people laugh.
words.example_cn: 妙语用来给笑话收尾,让人发笑。

words.example_en: Charlie Chaplin was a great actor and also a composer.
words.example_cn: 查理·卓别林既是伟大的演员,也是一位作曲家。

words.example_en: When a bee circled his face, Chaplin began to fall behind on the line.
words.example_cn: 一只蜜蜂在他脸旁飞来飞去时,卓别林开始跟不上流水线了。
